title: Sewer Clam
move_pattern: Alternates: Jet → Pressurize → Jet → Pressurize..., starting with Jet. Applies Strength each cycle to increase damage output.
notes: Sewer Clam uses a simple two-move cycle to become increasingly dangerous. It starts by attacking, then buffs itself with Strength, which increases its damage on subsequent Jet attacks. Gains additional Plating at A8+.
